notes.title: Store Page and Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I'm KurokumaSoft, a game developer from Japan.

Today, I released the Steam page and demo version of my new game, Boomer Grandma. This fast-paced boomer shooter is full of the fun that is unique to the genre.  Experience the pleasure that comes from killing demons!

The demo includes the first six levels. If you enjoy it, please support me by adding the game to your wishlist, checking back for updates, and promoting it on social media.

Development of the game is well underway, and the full version is scheduled for release in October 2025. If you have any feedback, please let me know!

I hope you enjoy the demo. See you soon!
